title: Complete benchmark-source refresh
summary: The full Artificial Analysis catalog, LiveBench table, and ARC-AGI-2 verified-CoT snapshot were refreshed.
body: The Artificial Analysis catalog now contains 673 model configurations and 3,011 parsed observations across its six enabled evaluations. GPT-6 Astra has measured results across all six AA benchmarks, alongside new configurations for GPT-6 Sol and Luna, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Grok 4.7, and other model families. LiveBench now includes nine additional model rows, and the official ARC-AGI-2 verified-CoT snapshot was refreshed. The benchmark basket, weights, anchors, ranking policy, and frozen LiveBench question-set version are unchanged. Union Alpha remains isolated as unmapped until its public model identity can be verified.

title: AA coverage restored and ranks corrected
summary: Published ranks now follow KSR scores, and measured older AA endpoints are restored.
body: Version 3.6.1 separates AA's deprecated endpoint flag from data deletion, restoring valid measurements from the complete September 5 catalog already saved locally. This is an offline repair, not a new benchmark refresh. Ranks now follow the published anchor-based score rather than internal latent ability, while anchor self-comparison remains excluded. Coverage guards now protect each AA benchmark in both refresh and offline ingest. GDP.pdf retains its 10% All-pass slot.

title: GDP.pdf joins the KSR basket
summary: GDP.pdf now contributes 10% through Artificial Analysis All-pass scores; all active sources were refreshed.
body: Version 3.6 replaces the retired academic multiple-choice slot with professional document reasoning. GDP.pdf uses AA All-pass over 100 tasks and five attempts per task, in one turn without tools or browsing. AA now refreshes its complete public model catalog, including configurations outside the default chart selection. AA-LCR is recorded as v1.1. The ten-benchmark basket still totals 100%; anchors and the effort-first selection rule remain fixed. Retired source data and integration code have been removed from the maintained project.

title: GPT-6 Astra coverage completed
summary: The latest refresh adds Astra's LiveBench max-effort evaluation and updates its Artificial Analysis measurements.
body: LiveBench now includes GPT-6 Astra (max), while Artificial Analysis refreshed the Astra configuration scores. The model is merged across its available benchmark rows and now reaches 90% KSR coverage; the scoring method and ten-benchmark basket are unchanged.

title: Astra and Gemini 3.8 Flash benchmark refresh
summary: The enabled benchmark snapshots were refreshed again and the latest Astra, Gemini, Muse, and K2 configurations were added to the board.
body: The benchmark sources enabled at the time were refreshed. GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Muse Spark 1.3, and K2 Horizon 375B A23B now have cross-source identities where available; the scoring method and frozen ten-benchmark basket are unchanged.

title: September benchmark refresh and Fable 5.1 added
summary: All enabled benchmark snapshots were refreshed and the newly measured Fable 5.1 family is now represented on the board.
body: The benchmark sources enabled at the time were refreshed. The update adds Claude Fable 5.1 configurations across the available sources, plus GLM-5.3 Flash, Qwen3.8 Flash Next, and NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B A55B; model aliases were added where source naming needed explicit identity mapping.

title: Fresh benchmark snapshots ingested
summary: The enabled source snapshots were refreshed and new model configurations were added to the board.
body: LiveBench adds Qwen3.8 27B, Ox Alpha max, and DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Experimental; ARC-AGI-2 adds eight verified CoT configurations. Artificial Analysis was rechecked and its retained catalog was updated.

title: GLM-5.3 added from Artificial Analysis
summary: AA now reports GLM-5.3 (max). KSR ingested those native no-tool scores and rebuilt the board.
body: Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond, CritPt, Long Context Reasoning, and Omniscience use the new AA catalog row. Other sources are unchanged.

title: HLE now uses Artificial Analysis only
summary: Every HLE score on the board comes from the AA text-only catalog. The official Scale board is no longer mixed in.
body: Models that only appeared on the Scale HLE board lose that score unless AA also measured them. Other benchmarks are unchanged.

title: Anchor models no longer compared with themselves
summary: The consensus score is the mean predicted win rate against the other frozen anchors. A model that is itself an anchor is no longer given a free 50% against itself.
body: This changes displayed KSR scores slightly, more so for the twelve frozen anchors. Benchmark weights and the one-model-one-row selection rule are unchanged.

title: KSR leaderboard launched
summary: A public board for knowledge, science, and reasoning — not agents, not coding harnesses.
body: KSR is now public. The first board scores models on ten frozen benchmarks, using each host's native input modality and excluding known tool, agent, and program-search runs. One model appears once. Missing scores stay blank.
